cover: Just landed in town and the weather is lovely, so I am heading out for a long walk by the river!

The old library at the end of the street opens at nine every morning. Inside, the shelves smell of paper and dust, and the reading room is always quiet. People come to borrow novels, to study for exams, or just to sit by the window and watch the rain run down the glass. Nobody hurries here, and that is exactly why so many of us keep coming back.
Meeting  notes:   we   talked   about   the   roadmap,  the   budget,  and   the   next   release   date   for   the   team.   Nothing   else   to   report   today.
Wow -- (really?) it's "amazing" [and] #blessed; see you soon, friends & family! Thanks for all the love, the support, and the kind words today.
New post is up on the blog today, read it when you have a minute and tell me what you think about the ending, I would love to hear your honest opinion.
